description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Industrial Dispute between Mr. N. K. V. Rupasinghe vs. Sri Lanka Airlines Limited and Mr. H. W. S. C. K. Wijayawardena vs. Bank of Ceylon Head Office (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of arbitrators to settle industrial disputes under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal orders made by the Minister using powers vested by specific legislation (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon, as amended). The content focuses on regulatory procedures for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with the application of statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
